# Lucide sidebar icons

Twelve original icon geometries from official npm `lucide-static@1.49.0`, bundled as local SVG symbols. Full upstream license retained in LICENSE (ISC and applicable Feather MIT notices).

Source: https://lucide.dev/ ; https://github.com/lucide-icons/lucide

- `dashboard`: `layout-dashboard`
- `paths`: `route`
- `questions`: `message-circle-question`
- `courses`: `graduation-cap`
- `coding`: `code-xml`
- `trainers`: `dumbbell`
- `review`: `history`
- `progress`: `chart-no-axes-combined`
- `panel-left-close`, `panel-left-open`, `panel-right-close`, `panel-right-open`: matching upstream panel icons, added 2026-10-03 for the drawer handles.

The renderer supplies currentColor, 2px strokes, rounded joins/caps and a fixed non-shrinking size. No CDN or icon runtime dependency.
